💡 Key Takeaways
  • In a recent development, on Friday, Google’s Gemini team announced the results of a new partnership with the wildfire-tracking app Watch Duty, after Gemini engineers spent six months embedded with Watch Duty’s first responders.
  • The Gemini AI improvements got a real-world test during Washington state’s Railroad Fire in July 2026, when Watch Duty issued what it calls its first-ever nighttime Critical Alert.
  • It has been revealed that “This is something the tool also has the capability to do if reports of flooding are communicated via radio,” said Dave Merritt, co-founder and chief technology officer of Watch Duty.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

In a recent development, on Friday, Google’s Gemini team announced the results of a new partnership with the wildfire-tracking app Watch Duty, after Gemini engineers spent six months embedded with Watch Duty’s first responders. The results cut vital new wildfire dispatch translations down to seconds and helped improve radio communications, which can be rough on the front lines of a new fire.

The Gemini AI improvements got a real-world test during Washington state’s Railroad Fire in July 2026, when Watch Duty issued what it calls its first-ever nighttime Critical Alert. The alert stemmed from a nearly unintelligible, static-filled 911 call that the Gemini tool transcribed in under 30 seconds. That kind of assistance can help Watch Duty send alerts to affected communities more quickly and enable first responders to update maps more accurately and make better-informed decisions.

It has been revealed that “This is something the tool also has the capability to do if reports of flooding are communicated via radio,” said Dave Merritt, co-founder and chief technology officer of Watch Duty. “Across disasters, we hear feedback every day that first responders are using Watch Duty for additional situational awareness, especially for disasters that span multiple counties.”.

Watch Duty reporters are active and retired first responders who can manually monitor up to 20 different feeds, though static and rapid-fire jargon can make them difficult to follow.

Gemini workers used more than 20,000 hours of Watch Duty radio recordings to train the AI tool to recognize firefighting terms that aren’t in the average dictionary or books that AIs are typically trained on.

Google states the tool is not designed to replace human decision-making in life-or-death situations.

“This tool takes on the demanding work of listening, freeing Watch Duty’s volunteers to focus on what matters most: confirming fires and getting warnings to people while they can still act,” said Stephanie Chew, Google project team lead.

The project was completed at no cost thanks to a Google.org fellowship, and the resulting Watch Duty app features are free to use.

From the data collected, Gemini engineers and Watch Duty identified several measures of success.

One metric was the word error rate, which fell by around 15% after the AI model was implemented. Another sign of success was a jump in Watch Duty volunteers’ satisfaction with their radio transcription tools, from around 35% to 92%.

The Gemini tool continues to analyze approximately 200 hours of radio speech traffic from 400 feeds per day. The tool was made to handle more than 10,000 radio feeds if necessary.

The integration could pave the way for broader use across public safety. The platform’s built-in scalability could eventually bring similar audio-clearing tools to local fire departments, 911 call centers and Coast Guard operations, where clear communication is critical under pressure.

Don’t Miss Out on GTA 6 Launch Week: Here’s How to Take Rockstar’s Latest Game Anywhere

⏱️ ~4 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Recent findings suggest that look, we weren’t all lucky enough to lock in PTO for the release of Grand Theft Auto 6.
  • A lot of folks are still working away, daydreaming about getting back on the sticks and knocking off corner stores as Jason and Lucia right now.
  • But even if you find yourself away from home, that doesn’t mean you’re completely locked out of playing GTA 6.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Recent findings suggest that look, we weren’t all lucky enough to lock in PTO for the release of Grand Theft Auto 6. Not everyone gets to write a review of the most anticipated video game in recent memory, or live blog their first 24 hours roaming around Vice City.

A lot of folks are still working away, daydreaming about getting back on the sticks and knocking off corner stores as Jason and Lucia right now. Some people are even on work trips or vacations away from their home consoles right now – let’s keep them in our thoughts.

But even if you find yourself away from home, that doesn’t mean you’re completely locked out of playing GTA 6. Sure, the game may right now be console-locked to the PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S, but there are still clever ways to get the game booted up when you’re on the go.

Here’s everything you need to know about the remote play features that you’ll need to take this modern Bonnie and Clyde story on the road.

So long as you have a PS5 or an Xbox with GTA 6 downloaded and ready to go, you can experience the game through smaller devices even when you’re away from home.

Both modern consoles support remote play, a feature that lets you stream your game from your home setup.

It has been revealed that if you’re looking to turn on the Xbox’s remote play feature, you need to access the Profile & System settings in the Xbox guide. From there, you need to navigate to the Devices & Connections menu and choose the Remote features option.

Industry observers note that you’ll need to enable the remote features and put your console into sleep mode in order to pair your chosen remote play device. Remote play devices include smartphones, tablets and Windows computers.

It has been revealed that gamers who own a PlayStation 5 will need to follow similar steps to get remote play functioning on a mobile device. Within the PlayStation’s settings menu, navigate to the System tab and choose Remote Play. Toggle the Enable Remote Play option. From there, all of the necessary device pairing and gameplay setup will happen through the PS Remote Play app, which you can download on your handheld device.

Whether you own a PlayStation or an Xbox, you’ll want to ensure your console settings are tuned so it stays connected to the internet in rest mode. You’ll also need to enable the console to turn on via a network connection. These settings will allow you to start a remote play session anytime, even if you’ve already left your home.

In a recent development, if you’re using PlayStation’s remote play feature, you don’t have to fiddle around with gaming tablets or third-party handheld devices in order to find a comfortable way to play GTA 6. Sony’s PlayStation Portal is the perfect console accessory for natural gameplay, since it retains the DualShock controller design.

Recent findings suggest that GTA 6 isn’t coming out on PC for a while still. That limits how many options you have when it comes to taking the game on the go with you. If (for whatever reason) you don’t have access to any remote play options, that leaves you with only the most inconvenient and unwieldy way to take the latest crime simulator with you on the road.

You’ll have to lug around your PS5 or Xbox wherever you go to get in some GTA time – but hey, at least the gaming industry’s deteriorating respect for physical media means you won’t have to keep track of a disc.

The PS5 Slim is probably the easiest current-gen console to carry with you, since the digital edition weighs less than 6 pounds. But you’re giving up the best possible performance available on the PS5 Pro.

Either way, you’ll be carrying around a large, expensive piece of hardware, so this option should only be considered if you really can’t get remote play functioning for whatever reason.

Microsoft’s video game ecosystem is huge, with Game Pass and streaming options available for PC players. But the Xbox brand isn’t offering gamers a cheat code to play GTA 6 on their beefy rigs (or any convenient handheld devices).

According to recent reports, GTA 6 is only available on Xbox consoles with Xbox Cloud Gaming at this time. The upside is that this option lets you play the boundary-pushing new game on the Xbox One, which is very close to being two console generations old.

At that point, you’re better off biting the bullet on a current-generation console and considering the available remote play options.

Trying to Use Up Your FSA Funds Before 2026 Ends? 5 Things You Can Spend Them On

📅 22 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 2 min read (492 words, 📖 Standard) | Source: Fool

⏱️ ~2 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • By Kailey Hagen, CFP® – Nov 22, 2026 at 10:50AM EST.
  • It has been revealed that flexible spending accounts (FSAs) sound like a great idea in theory: You can set aside pre-tax dollars to cover your annual healthcare expenses, so that money is available when you need it.
  • Recent findings suggest that that usually leads to a mad scramble around the end of the year to spend any remaining FSA funds before the Dec.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By Kailey Hagen, CFP® – Nov 22, 2026 at 10:50AM EST.

It has been revealed that flexible spending accounts (FSAs) sound like a great idea in theory: You can set aside pre-tax dollars to cover your annual healthcare expenses, so that money is available when you need it. But if you don't use it all up by the end of the year, you can forfeit whatever is left in the account.

Recent findings suggest that that usually leads to a mad scramble around the end of the year to spend any remaining FSA funds before the Dec. 31 deadline. Some employers give you an extra two-and-a-half months to use your remaining funds or allow you to carry over up to $680 of your FSA funds into 2027. Check with your employer if you're not sure how your proposal works.

If neither of those are options for you, you can spend your remaining FSA dollars on the following five things:.

Sources indicate that if you've been putting off a checkup or a specialist visit all year, now is a great time to fit one in. Use your FSA-eligible costs to cover any associated expenses, including diagnostic tests or specific treatments. Dental and vision care count as well.

Similar to health savings accounts (HSAs), FSAs enable you to spend your money on prescription medications as well as over-the-counter drugs. If you need to refill your prescription soon, try to fit it in before the end of the year so you can use your FSA funds. Or restock your medicine cabinet with pain relievers, bandages, and other items you might need over the next year.

Sources indicate that therapy can be an FSA-eligible expense if it's used to treat a medical condition. If you have any questions about whether your therapy counts, talk with your FSA provider to learn more.

If you need things like diabetic monitors or test strips, hearing aids, or a walking aid, you can use your FSA funds to pay for these expenses. Take stock of your current medical equipment and what might need replacing soon. Then, see if you can find any good deals on new versions in the next few weeks.

You can also use your remaining FSA funds to get up to date on your vaccinations if you're behind on any. Just make sure you squeeze them in before the end of the year.

Keep your receipts for all of these items. The IRS is free to request itemized receipts if it wants to verify the eligibility of your purchases.

#62414. Industry News: I Didn’t Know Southwest Points Could Be This Valuable

📅 19 Nov 2026 • ⏱️ 8m • 📚 Deep Dive (1651 w)
📖 Baca
General ⚖️ Neutral 🌐 Nerdwallet ↗ Open Full Page

Industry News: I Didn’t Know Southwest Points Could Be This Valuable

📅 19 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 8 min read (1651 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Nerdwallet

⏱️ ~8 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Industry observers note that in a world of transferable points currencies, you might not think holding an airline or hotel credit card is necessary.
  • Take Southwest Airlines, for example.
  • "Experiences create lifetime memories,” says Nandika Suri, Southwest’s vice president of Rapid Rewards.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Industry observers note that in a world of transferable points currencies, you might not think holding an airline or hotel credit card is necessary. But travel brands are pushing back against that narrative, offering exclusive perks and redemption packages to those who carry their cards.

Take Southwest Airlines, for example. Its Rapid Rewards loyalty program allows you to redeem points for flights, but it also offers a special program called Rapid Rewards Access Events exclusively for Southwest credit cardholders. In exchange for a decent chunk of points, you can get a vacation package that’s worth significantly more than the price you pay. Instead of a traditional flight award redemption, you get a cohesive travel experience.

"Experiences create lifetime memories,” says Nandika Suri, Southwest’s vice president of Rapid Rewards. “For us, we really want them to have great memories and remember our brand as part of that.”.

It has been revealed that southwest invited me to participate in one of its Rapid Rewards Access Events. While Southwest covered the cost of my trip, these opinions are my own. Here’s what I learned.

Every event is different (ranging from concerts to multiday trips), but big-ticket Rapid Rewards Access Events tend to include flights, hotel accommodations, meals and excursions.

The event I participated in was in Maui to celebrate the 30th anniversary of Southwest and Chase’s partnership. This was a bigger production than the typical event, with about 60 cardholders (and a plus one) participating. A typical multiday event might have 20 or 25 packages for sale.

In exchange for 275,000 Rapid Rewards points, cardholders received for themselves and one guest:.

A four-night stay in an ocean-view room at the Grand Wailea, a Waldorf Astoria Resort, in Maui, including daily breakfast.

Ground transportation between the airport and the resort, as well as for any scheduled group activities.

A special welcome reception and farewell dinner.

A snorkeling cruise with lunch and beverages included.

A choice between several excursions, including a spa treatment, golf, ziplining and more.

Even at extremely conservative estimates, I would value all of those things at roughly $4,600. That’s $750 more than what NerdWallet values 275,000 Rapid Rewards points at, according to our 2026 data. If we took a more liberal approach, I think it would be fair to say the package was worth more than $7,000. That puts this redemption between 1.7 and 2.5 cents per point. (Expand the section below to see how I arrived at those numbers.).

In a recent development, as of 2026, NerdWallet values Southwest Rapid Rewards points at 1.4 cents apiece. That puts the 275,000-point Southwest event package at $3,850.

Let’s put some numbers to the package inclusions and see how the points price stacks up to the cash valuation.

Sources indicate that $1,000 Southwest gift card: It’s pretty easy to value a $1,000 Southwest gift card at $1,000. You need to fly to the event, so that can be taken at face value. (You could also use it toward a different trip, if you wanted to use points or fly with a different carrier.).

In a recent development, four-night hotel stay: For the Grand Wailea stay, a nonrefundable Hilton Honors discount rate for an ocean-view room on the exact same dates in 2027 costs $4,490.19, after factoring in taxes and fees. (The base-level terrace-view room would cost $3,992.17.).

If you were to use points, a standard room without an ocean view would cost 130,000 Hilton points per night. An ocean-view room’s rate shoots up to 281,000 Hilton points per night.

According to recent reports, using NerdWallet’s 2026 valuation of Hilton points at 0.4 cent per point, that puts the value of the two rooms at $2,080 and $4,496, respectively. To make things interesting, let’s say the hotel stay is worth $2,080.

Industry observers note that daily breakfast at the hotel buffet is about $60 per person, before tax and tip. For four days, let’s put that at around another $500, bringing the total stay value to $2,580.

In a recent development, ground transportation: Let’s make things simple and just say it’s $30 each way between the airport and the resort. For two people, that would be worth $120.

Welcome reception and farewell dinner: Southwest and Chase put a lot of effort into making these events nice, from the food and free-flowing alcohol to the entertainment (there was even a fire performance at the farewell dinner).

I would value this at $50 per person, conservatively, or $200 total.

Snorkeling cruise: I went on Viator to find a similar experience, and the cheapest option I found was priced at $100 per person.

Again, let’s price it conservatively and say it’s worth $200. That price doesn't include hotel transportation, gratuities, towels or alcoholic beverages, while the Southwest package did.

Excursion choice: Southwest let everyone choose an excursion, ranging from a chill pool or spa day to ziplining through the jungle or learning to surf.

It’s hard to put a number on this, because the activities varied in cost.

In a recent development, I went ziplining, and it was $240 for six lines. That price doesn’t include transportation to the excursion, which was covered by Southwest. Meanwhile, a standard massage at the hotel spa is $275 (and that doesn’t even factor in the 20% service charge).

Let’s put this at $250 per person, giving us a round $500 for two people’s excursions.

In a recent development, grand total: Summing up these numbers gets us $4,600. That’s $750 more than the $3,850 NerdWallet values 275,000 points at, but keep in mind that we probably undervalued several of the inclusions. The actual value of a trip like this could be much higher.

It also doesn’t factor in other things, like snacks provided at the hospitality booth, as well as surprise gifts and goodie bags prepared by Southwest and Chase for attendees.

Before you book a Rapid Rewards Access Event, there are some drawbacks to booking a vacation this way.

The biggest one is if you don’t like group trips or following a schedule on your vacations. Given the nature of these events, you’ll be surrounded by a group of travelers, many of whom will likely be longtime Southwest flyers. If you prefer to keep to yourself, then this type of trip is likely not a good fit.

According to recent reports, you’ll also have multiple scheduled activities on your itinerary. While you can choose to not show up, those activities add a lot of value to the trip.

Recent findings suggest that with that remarked, I found the itinerary quite laid back. The amount of scheduled activities wasn’t overwhelming, and there was plenty of free time to do whatever you wanted. One couple I met even rented a car and explored Maui in their downtime, so they kept themselves busy.

These events are extremely popular, and many attendees I met at the Maui event had been on multiple Southwest cardmember trips.

Scoring a ticket to a Rapid Rewards Access Event might even require setting your alarm for when tickets drop. Several cardmembers told me they’ve experienced times when the event they wanted was sold out in hours, if not minutes. (The Maui one took a few hours to sell out, because it was larger than most.).

According to recent reports, finally, 275,000 points is a lot — even if you're getting great value. If your Rapid Rewards points are collecting dust in your account, then it could make sense. But if you have a transferable currency, then you'd have to weigh whether you might get better value elsewhere, such as booking round-trip business class flights.

Sources indicate that southwest isn’t the only airline or travel brand to offer special events for cardholders. United Airlines has MileagePlus Exclusives and United Card Events from Chase; Delta Air Lines offers cardmember-exclusive redemptions in its SkyMiles Experiences program; and Marriott has its Marriott Bonvoy Moments program.

But every redemption option is different — even if it’s within the same loyalty program. For example, some Rapid Rewards Access Events are packages you can purchase immediately for a set price, while others are auction-style listings. Some programs offer paid experiences, so you can only pay in cash, not points.

Industry observers note that personally, I’m a fan of the fixed-price points option. You know the upfront price, and you don’t have to worry about getting into a last-minute bidding war that could lead you to paying more than you intended. Plus, Southwest has historically had limited award redemption options, although that will change in 2027 when it allows international partner award bookings.

Ultimately, whether you think a Rapid Rewards Access Event is a worthwhile redemption will depend on your interests, and Southwest is working to expand its offerings to meet people’s passions.

"We do offer a lot of breadth because we want to get different types of customers engaged with different types of things based on their individual passion points and what they're really interested in,” notes Suri, the Rapid Rewards chief.

If you’d rather spend time in the mountains than on the beach, you might not want to spend 275,000 Rapid Rewards points on the Maui package.

Instead, you probably would've been interested in the 250,000-point package for "Boots, Bourbon and Bonfires" — a three-day trip to Devil's Thumb Ranch, an upscale dude ranch resort about 1.5 hours outside of Denver.

Before you book, just remember: You’ll need a Southwest credit card to purchase.

Industry News: Microsoft unveiled Copilot Workspaces at Ignite 2026, plus more AI workplace updates

📅 17 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 4 min read (767 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Zdnet

💡 Key Takeaways
  • AI-powered workspaces are tech companies’ latest focus, as the industry still struggles to perfect adoption.
  • During the keynote for the tech giant’s Ignite conference on Tuesday, CEO Satya Nadella revealed Copilot Workspaces, a collaborative, “multiplayer” surface for Copilot’s agentic capabilities.
  • Also: Microsoft says its latest AI coding model rivals Claude Opus 5.5 at 5% of the cost.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

AI-powered workspaces are tech companies’ latest focus, as the industry still struggles to perfect adoption. Microsoft has just put its offering into the ring.

During the keynote for the tech giant’s Ignite conference on Tuesday, CEO Satya Nadella revealed Copilot Workspaces, a collaborative, “multiplayer” surface for Copilot’s agentic capabilities.

Also: Microsoft says its latest AI coding model rivals Claude Opus 5.5 at 5% of the cost.

The product, available in Frontier for now, is similar to OpenAI’s ChatGPT Space and several latest Anthropic features, including Whiteboard and Sheets, which essentially merge the work tools you’re used to using with an agentic framework.

“As the evolution of Copilot Notebooks, it’s where people and agents build on each other’s work,” Microsoft noted. “An agent drafts a section of a document, and you review. You leave a comment, and an agent picks it up.”.

Microsoft also announced Autopilot, a sort of counterpoint agent to Copilot that “can watch Teams channels, follow up on emails, run recurring work, and manage a project — without waiting for a prompt,” as Microsoft described.

In a demo video during the keynote, the agent appeared to function similarly to OpenAI’s Dots, but for work — employees can tag their Autopilot “like a colleague,” Microsoft noted, and assign it tasks.

Also: 4 ways Anthropic’s newly introduced Claude Sheets beat using a Google Sheets connector.

Microsoft stated the agent will be able to autonomously handle “meetings and follow-ups on its own,” though that claim may be best verified by teams themselves.

Speaking of trust, however, Microsoft noted that “Autopilot runs on the identity, security, and compliance foundation IT already uses,” and that “each Autopilot has its own Microsoft Entra Agent ID and a named manager,” meaning IT can block it as needed.

“Its sign-ins and actions are logged under its own name, so security teams have a clear audit trail. Powered by Work IQ, it understands how your organization works within existing permissions,” Microsoft said.

Recent findings suggest that the manufacturer added that employees will soon “be able to bring their personal Autopilot into Workspaces” as well. The feature is also available in Frontier.

Nadella also revealed a few other productivity features, including a “command center” called Today that spans email, calendar, meetings, tasks, and threads in Teams. At the moment in private preview in Outlook and the Copilot app, it includes a personalized briefing and a feed of priorities that updates throughout the day.

“The draft is written and ready for you to edit; the schedule change is already proposed; and the forgotten follow-up is waiting for you to send it, complete with context so you can catch up quickly,” Microsoft said of the feature, which sounds like an agentic briefing-cum-morning-assistant.

Also: Nearly 70% of workers use AI regularly now – but many get no time to upskill.

Industry observers note that microsoft also announced that Home, now generally available, unifies Chat and Cowork into a singular starting point. That’s similar to Anthropic’s recent consolidation of its chat and agentic Cowork offerings, demonstrating an overall trend toward simplification in workplace AI.

While more companies are finally starting to see a return on their AI investment, agents are still expensive and can quickly rack up costs when unsupervised.

Microsoft confirmed a few tools to track this at Ignite: Agent 365 Business Analytics and Agent 365 Cost Management.

Also: Microsoft wants to put a dollar value on AI’s work – but can you trust the math?

In a recent development, agent 365, which Microsoft declared last year, is the company’s observability platform. Microsoft mentioned Business Analytics, in Frontier Public today, provides insights on what a company is spending on AI and why, and where it’s paying off, as well as forecasts future costs. In a demo during the keynote, Microsoft demonstrated how admins can see when specific agents’ costs have spiked recently and what (human) employee to notify as a result.

Industry observers note that “It starts with a latest way to measure your investment: in work completed, not simply tokens,” Microsoft stated. “It analyzes the tasks, how long that work typically takes a person, and the share Cowork performed, providing a sophisticated view of the hours your intelligence supports and what the work is worth.”.

Cost Management lets IT see where teams are using AI down to the model.

Sources indicate that “Leaders can set spending policies, limits, and proactive alerts and control which models are available,” Microsoft stated. Anthropic released a similar tool last month, though it was focused more on making seats as efficient as possible on Teams and Enterprise plans.

iOS 27.3 Could Bring the Redesigned Health App and a More Capable Siri AI to Your Device Soon

📅 20 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 5 min read (1065 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Cnet

⏱️ ~5 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Industry observers note that apple debuted the second public beta of iOS 27.3 on Thursday, Nov.
  • Apple historically releases an iOS enhancement in December, so I expect iOS 27.3 to land on iPhones later this year.
  • Since this is a beta, I recommend downloading it on something other than your primary device.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Industry observers note that apple debuted the second public beta of iOS 27.3 on Thursday, Nov. 19, more than two months after the launch of the iPhone 18 Pro lineup and iOS 27. The headliner here is the return of the new Health app: After briefly testing the redesigned Health app in an early iOS 27.2 beta, Apple has put the revamped app back in the recent beta cycle.

Apple historically releases an iOS enhancement in December, so I expect iOS 27.3 to land on iPhones later this year.

Since this is a beta, I recommend downloading it on something other than your primary device. This isn’t the final version of iOS 27.3, so the update might be buggy and battery life may be short, so it’s best to keep those troubles on a secondary device.

Also, since this isn’t the final version, there could be more features to land on your iPhone when Apple releases 27.3.

Here are some features developers and beta testers can try now in the second iOS 27.3 beta.

According to recent reports, the redesigned Health app returns in the iOS 27.3 beta after Apple tested the feature in the iOS 27.2 beta process. Developers and beta testers can explore the refreshed app and see things like a latest Longevity tab and your Health Age.

Apple wrote online that we can expect the redesigned Health app to land on devices later this year.

If developers and beta testers have an Apple Watch that is running the watchOS 27.3 beta as well as an iPhone running the iOS 27.3 beta, those folks can test out Apple’s Live Rewind and Siri Recap in Audio Intelligence.

According to recent reports, live Rewind allows you to pull up a text transcript of a conversation in the past 15 seconds on your Apple Watch, and Siri Recap can automatically give you a summary of meetings, conversations and other events. Live Rewind snippets are replaced by latest audio and then deleted, and Siri Recaps delete themselves after seven days if you don’t manually delete them sooner. However, you can also save both of these in the Siri app and export them to the Notes or Journal apps on your iPhone.

While both Live Rewind and Siri Recap are automatically deleted over time, I’m uncomfortable with the ability to save snippets or recaps, which raises concerns about people recording my conversations without my knowledge. Even if Audio Intelligence just summarizes what I remarked, I still find both features creepy.

And while I recognize the utility for certain groups of people, I also think it’s better to just, y’know… talk to someone instead of asking your watch what they just said.

It has been revealed that siri AI gets a huge patch in the iOS 27.3 beta. The feature can now do more actions in supported apps, like Apple Music and Messages. For example, if you go into Apple Music, you can ask Siri to create a playlist for you, and in Messages, you can ask Siri to schedule, edit or unsend messages. If you open an app and ask Siri what it can do, the digital assistant should give you some examples of its capabilities.

Recent findings suggest that you can also use Siri in Safari to scan an entire webpage — even parts of the page that aren’t in your direct view — to give you helpful information. So if you are looking at a menu online, you can ask Siri to find the gluten-free or vegetarian options.

The beta also brings Siri AI to traditional Chinese, Vietnamese, Turkish and Norwegian.

In the latest iOS 27.3 beta, developers and beta testers can find video podcasts in the Apple TV app, as well as in the Podcasts app. You can find video podcasts by going into the app, tapping Home across the bottom of your screen and scrolling down to the Video Podcasts section.

This means you can watch a video podcast in the Apple TV app on your iPhone while commuting, and then you can finish that video later on an Apple TV 4K or another device with access to Apple TV.

Industry observers note that each workout recommends exercises, reps, sets and weights in order to help you meet your goals. And if you’re unfamiliar with an exercise, you can also watch video tutorials to see how to perform that exercise.

Industry observers note that standBy mode also gets an upgrade in the iOS 27.3 beta. In the beta, you can add full weather and calendar slides to the mode and choose from more colors.

Industry observers note that apple introduced StandBy mode alongside iOS 17, and it was one of my favorite iPhone features. I’m happy Apple is finally showing it some love and adding more features and capabilities so it feels more like a home or desk hub.

Industry observers note that if you’re a fan of dark mode, the iOS 27.3 beta has a treat for you. The beta gives you a fresh setting in Safari called Adaptive Dark Mode. When enabled, it forces dark mode onto webpages in Safari that may not have a dark mode option otherwise.

Here’s where to find the option.

1. Tap Settings.2. Tap Apps.3. Tap Safari.4. Tap Adaptive Dark Mode.5. Tap On.

If you have an iPhone Duo and are running the iOS 27.3 beta, you have fresh options to lock and unlock your device. In the beta, you can enable your device to lock simply by closing the Duo. You can find this option in Settings and within the Display & Brightness menu.

Recent findings suggest that next, people with the Duo can unlock the device using that phone’s front camera and without opening the foldable. You will have had to recently unlocked your device with Touch ID or your passcode. You can find this option in Settings and in the Touch ID & Passcode menu.

Sources indicate that those are a few of the upcoming features developers can try now with the second beta of iOS 27.3. Apple has not remarked when exactly it will release iOS 27.3 to the general public, but we expect it to land on devices before the end of the year.

For more iOS news, here’s what to know about iOS 27.2, why you may have missed iOS 27.1 and our iOS 27 cheat sheet.

Microsoft’s latest Licensed Weights lets businesses customize AI models with their own data

📅 18 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 3 min read (518 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Zdnet

⏱️ ~3 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Sources indicate that during the keynote at its Ignite conference on Tuesday, Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella announced several new models from Microsoft AI (MAI), its lab within the firm.
  • Also: Microsoft states its new AI coding model rivals Claude Opus 5.5.
  • MAI said it would allow its customers to customize its frontier models with their own data and run them securely in Azure through an initiative called Licensed Weights.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Sources indicate that during the keynote at its Ignite conference on Tuesday, Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella announced several new models from Microsoft AI (MAI), its lab within the firm. But new model releases are almost a dime a dozen these days, and accelerating fast — what really stood out was how Microsoft will let its customers access those models.

Also: Microsoft states its new AI coding model rivals Claude Opus 5.5.

MAI said it would allow its customers to customize its frontier models with their own data and run them securely in Azure through an initiative called Licensed Weights. It’s essentially a selective approach to open-weight AI: more so than proprietary models from OpenAI and Anthropic, but not fully downloadable on Hugging Face like Mistral’s Le Chonk. Interested companies will need to go through their Microsoft account reps to get started.

Sources indicate that “You control who can access it. Your data and adaptations stay entirely yours. And we’ll work with you through Frontier Organization to deliver the custom model and embed it in your own products and agents,” Mustafa Suleyman, CEO of MAI, remarked during the keynote.

The approach should stand out to businesses looking for affordable AI that lets them retain control over their IP. Microsoft said it would only use customers’ information to train its models if they agreed.

“No one wants to pour their IQ into someone else’s model,” Suleyman stated during the keynote, a nod to an argument Palantir CEO Alex Karp has made repeatedly.

The dominant, if simplified, narrative in AI has been that proprietary, expensive models boast peak capabilities but aren’t customizable, while open, cheaper models are customizable but less capable. Microsoft’s AI models don’t necessarily compete with OpenAI and Anthropic yet, but the tech giant has legacy sway with countless businesses. By offering a customizable AI option, it could strike a balance among major tech companies.

Industry observers note that western labs, including Thinking Machines and Mistral, are releasing more competitive open-weight models, but Anthropic and OpenAI still have the overwhelming majority of the enterprise AI market. Though Licensed Weights isn’t an open-weight family of models, it does diversify the open-versus-closed debate a bit and differentiate Microsoft’s offering from OpenAI’s and Anthropic’s. It’s also a smart pairing with Microsoft’s goal to balance price and performance, if businesses find it impressive enough.

Also: Microsoft unveiled Copilot Workspaces at Ignite 2026.

“Averaged over four widely used benchmarks that target the everyday enterprise coding tasks we see in GitHub Copilot, MAI Code 2 gives you 98% of the performance of GPT 6.1 Sol at just 40% of the cost, and against Opus 5.5 it’s an incredible 5% of that cost,” Suleyman remarked of the new coding model the manufacturer confirmed at Ignite.

The firm also released its new image editing model, MAI Image 2.7, on Tuesday, which now leads the category on Artificial Analysis while beating Nano Banana Pro and several GPT image models on price and quality. With Licensed Weights, Microsoft has positioned itself for organizations seeking a reliable blend of ROI tools, customization, security controls, and capability.

💡 Key Takeaways
  • By Robert Izquierdo – Updated Nov 22, 2026 at 10:53AM EST.
  • Investors today can choose the high-growth potential of international e-commerce against the steady profitability of domestic retail leaders.
  • Coupang has revolutionized logistics in Asia, while DICK'S Sporting Goods is consolidating the North American athletic market.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By Robert Izquierdo – Updated Nov 22, 2026 at 10:53AM EST.

10 stocks we like better than Coupang ›.

Investors today can choose the high-growth potential of international e-commerce against the steady profitability of domestic retail leaders. Deciding between Coupang (CPNG +1.49%) and DICK'S Sporting Goods (DKS -2.86%) requires balancing expansion with valuation.

Coupang has revolutionized logistics in Asia, while DICK'S Sporting Goods is consolidating the North American athletic market. Both companies are utilizing loyalty programs to retain customers in a competitive environment. This comparison explores their financial health, risk factors, and market pricing to determine which stock is better positioned for the next few years.

Coupang operates a massive e-commerce network primarily in South Korea, offering services like Rocket Delivery and Coupang Play. The company maintains a significant number of customer accounts, though it experienced a major data breach involving 33 million accounts last year that hurt its reputation. Its WOW membership program remains the core driver of engagement today.

In the 12 months ended Sept. 30, 2026, revenue reached $36.2 billion, representing a growth rate of 7.4% compared to the prior period. Despite this growth, the firm reported a net loss of $1.4 billion during this specific timeframe, resulting in a negative net margin of 3.8%. This performance highlights the high costs associated with logistics expansion and recent acquisitions.

As of its December 2025 balance sheet, the debt-to-equity ratio was 1.0x, meaning its total debt is equal to its shareholder equity. The current ratio, which measures a manufacturer's ability to pay short-term obligations with short-term assets, was 1.0x. In the fiscal year ended Dec. 31, 2025, free cash flow was $522.0 million. Note that stock-based compensation (SBC) represented 26.8% of operating cash flow, which inflates reported cash generation since SBC is a non-cash expense added back in the cash flow statement.

In a recent development, DICK'S Sporting Goods is a dominant player among retail stocks, operating over 850 locations across the United States. The firm recently expanded its reach by acquiring the Foot Locker chain, which includes brands like Champs Sports and WSS. Its ScoreCard loyalty program includes nearly 30 million members who provide the company with valuable data on consumer spending habits.

In the 12 months ended Aug. 1, 2026, revenue reached $21.1 billion, a significant increase of 53.5% over the previous year. The tech giant remained solidly profitable during this period, generating net income of $838.8 million, which equates to a net margin of 4%. This surge in revenue largely reflects the integration of newly acquired retail banners into its existing operations.

Industry observers note that as of its January 2026 balance sheet, the debt-to-equity ratio was 1.4x, indicating that total debt is 40% higher than shareholder equity. The current ratio was 1.5x, suggesting the manufacturer has a comfortable cushion to cover its upcoming bills. In the fiscal year ended Jan. 31, 2026, free cash flow was $400.2 million, providing capital for further expansion or acquisitions.

Coupang faces intense competition from both online and offline retailers while navigating a highly regulated environment in South Korea regarding labor and data privacy. The company is currently dealing with the fallout from a data incident and the complex integration of Farfetch, an entity that has historically faced material weaknesses in internal controls. Additionally, regulatory investigations into its bundling practices could disrupt its long-term trajectory.

Industry observers note that DICK'S Sporting Goods must manage the risks of a slowdown in consumer discretionary spending and the complexity of its expanded omnichannel platform. The tech giant is currently facing a securities class action lawsuit related to the inventory position of its Foot Locker acquisition. Furthermore, it relies heavily on key vendors like Nike (NKE -4.11%) and must contend with rising retail theft and regional economic fluctuations that impact store performance.

DICK'S Sporting Goods is cheaper based on its Forward P/E, which uses future earnings estimates, and its P/S ratio relative to sales over the past twelve months.

Valuation metrics include sourcing from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP) and may differ from other data providers.

Industry observers note that both Coupang and DICK'S have experienced significant stock sell-offs in 2026 due to distinct operational and regulatory setbacks. The former's data breach incident contributed to revenue growth decelerating year over year, while a fire at its Incheon fulfillment center contributed to recent operating losses. The sporting goods retailer's acquisition of Foot Locker exposed it to the shoe industry's declining sales.

Over the long run, both are likely to rebound as current headwinds subside, but between the two, I would invest in DICK'S. While Coupang dominates South Korean e-commerce and it is attempting to expand to other countries, it is not profitable.

Meanwhile, DICK'S has been profitable for years, and it offers investors a robust dividend yield of 3.8%. Its share price valuation is also superior, as demonstrated by its far lower forward earnings multiple, which is at a low point for the past year. With its stock beaten down, now is a good time to pick up DICK'S shares going into 2027.

  • Also: I’ve used Ubuntu for 22 years – and 26.10 might be its best release yet.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Sources indicate that ubuntu 27.04, Tenacious T-Rex, is set for an April 22, 2027 release. Although that seems a long way off, it’s sooner than you think. As is implied by the release number, 27.04 is not an LTS release, so it only receives support for nine months (until January 2028). The good news is that you can migrate from 27.04 to 27.10, and then to the LTS release, 28.04. The entire upgrade path ensures that you don’t have to miss a single release.

Industry observers note that but what’s coming in Ubuntu 27.04? Given that it’s an interim release, you’re probably assuming that there’ll be nothing exciting to be found. Although there won’t be any game-changing additions, there will be plenty of refinements and bug fixes.

Also: I’ve used Ubuntu for 22 years – and 26.10 might be its best release yet.

I’ve been using the daily release of Ubuntu 27.04 for a bit. Let’s take a look at what is presently expected in Tenacious T-Rex.

This is probably the biggest addition to the next release of Ubuntu. And although you won’t find any major changes in GNOME, there are some notable ones. First off, there will be editable quick settings, which allow for customizing, adding, removing, and rearranging toggles and widgets. GNOME 52 will also enjoy a revamped calendar popover, which streamlines the feature to focus primarily on events, time, and weather.

Also: Over Ubuntu? Fedora is the Linux distro I’d hop to next – here’s why.

There will also be several improvements to window management, such as a spatial overview and a mosaic/tiling system for auto-resizing and organizing windows, a refined full-screen Alt+Tab app switcher, which will be capable of grouping older windows by application while showing newer ones individually, and finally, the ability to remember window sizing, placement, and workspace.

Recent findings suggest that desktop search is also getting a bit of polish by way of a redesigned popover and an improved results overlay that includes file previews, multiple actions, and search filters. And, as usual, there will be plenty of bug fixes and performance enhancements. The bump in speed is noticeable, too, in my testing.

Ubuntu 27.04 will ship with the Linux 7.6 kernel, which includes better VRAM management for gaming and expanded support for modern hardware, such as early enablement for AMD Zen 6, stable support for Intel Xe3P, mainline boot capabilities for Apple M3 Pro/Max/Ultra, and initial support for the 2026 Steam Controller.

There will also be performance gains for both the Btrfs and Ext4 file systems, which (along with the improvements in GNOME 52) will make Ubuntu 27.04 one of the best-performing releases in some time.

Also: This lightweight Linux distro revives old PCs destined for the junk pile – and it’s beautiful.

It has been revealed that one thing that surprised me is that Myna (Ubuntu’s AI dictation tool) has yet to find its way into the Ubuntu ISO as a default app. As with Ubuntu 26.10, you can install it, but you have to first add the necessary repository with:.

With the repository added, you can install it with:.

Once installed, you can use it as expected.

As of right now, that’s all we know about Tenacious T-Rex.

It’s so early in the release cycle that it still uses the default 26.10 wallpaper, but there will be more information soon. I will say this: I’ve come to count on Ubuntu’s latest releases to be an improvement over the previous iterations, and from what I’ve seen so far in my testing, 27.04 will not disappoint. It may not knock you back to prehistoric times, but Tenacious T-Rex will wow you with its performance and polished looks.

Also: Linux has hundreds of distros: 5 reasons to stop using the same few.

It’s been a very long time since Canonical had a disappointing release, and 27.04 will keep up that trend.

In a recent development, if you use an AI chatbot and you’re concerned about your privacy and the personal information it ingests, you can do something about it. While Claude — our top pick for AI chatbots — is one of the better options when it comes to privacy, the default settings can still leave something to be desired if you value yours.

Luckily, you can mitigate or even eliminate the amount of data Claude knows about you, as long as you know where to look.

From having Claude train on your conversations to track your location and more, here are a series of settings you should consider changing if you want to stay on top of your privacy when using one of the best AI chatbots around.

By default, most AI chatbots have a setting on by default that allows them to be trained on the conversations you have. This is the first and likely the most important setting you need to disable. Here’s how to turn it off.

The settings essentially remain the same across web, iOS and Android:.

You may not see this option because with some accounts, like Enterprise plans, Claude doesn’t automatically collect this data. So if you have a Claude account through work, you might not have to worry about this.

While you’re at it, if you’re a Claude Code user, these settings will let you delete Code sessions stored on Anthropic’s server without deleting local sessions on your computer.

If you’ve ever shared a chat with anyone, you can also delete those chats in this menu as well.

Read More: Keep Your Data Yours: How to Opt Out of AI Chatbot Training.

Anthropic will use your location when using Claude to “improve product experience.” It will use your device’s IP address to identify your city and region, but you can disable this setting — to some extent. How you go about doing this will depend on what device you’re using to access Claude.

According to the support article, if you’re using the mobile app (iOS or Android) or the web extension, the location settings are located within the device’s settings and not the Claude app settings. However, I found two ways to do this on Android. (See below.).

The Claude app will not request access to your location unless your prompt has a specific location-based query, like “What are some of the best sushi restaurants around me?” Only then will the app request permission.

However, if you already have given Claude access on Android or iOS, here’s how you can revoke permission.

I was surprised to see a section in the Settings of the Android app that I didn’t see on iOS, but it will also allow you to disable your location right from the app.

One thing to keep in mind is that turning your location off can affect features like searches that require your location, but Anthropic explicitly states that it collects your IP address to infer coarse-grained location to ensure usage of Claude complies with its terms and to prevent abuse — despite questionable allegations.

In a recent development, like other AI chatbots, Claude has built-in “memory” so it can more easily have context about your conversations. Memory is on by default: The chatbot will remember personal preferences and other information and will be able to take that into consideration in other conversations, even if you don’t explicitly mention it in your current session.

If you’d prefer a clean slate, you can ask in the chat what memories it has collected about you and then tell Claude to delete specific memories or all of them. However, there’s a dedicated section in the settings to help you view and manage memories directly.

In the web version of Claude, do the following to access your memory settings:.

This will display all stored memories Claude has for you. You can edit a specific memory to your liking by clicking on the pencil icon on the right side of the memory or delete it entirely by clicking on the trash icon.

To prevent Claude from creating fresh memories from your conversations:.

Industry observers note that if you have had conversations with Claude that were sensitive in nature and still had the “Help improve our AI models” option enabled, odds are that Anthropic has already trained Claude on that conversation. There’s no way to change that.

However, you should find those conversations in your chat history and delete them. After you’ve done that and disabled AI training on your conversations, you should opt for incognito mode for any further sensitive conversations you might want to have going forward.

Incognito chats aren’t saved in your history, nor are they used to train models.

Recent findings suggest that some of the most popular Android smartwatches just got a battery-saving revision. Google released an updated version of Google Play Services on Tuesday that can help extend the battery life of a Wear OS smartwatch.

The v26.45 update concerns location tracking during outdoor workouts. Wear OS smartwatch consumers can now use their phone’s Global Navigation Satellite System to track their location during an outdoor workout, which can conserve battery life by outsourcing the smartwatch’s energy to the smartphone when it isn’t in Battery Saver mode.

Industry observers note that also: Pixel Watch 4 vs. Watch 5: Is Google’s new model worth it?

Industry observers note that constantly communicating with satellites during an outdoor workout can be a battery drain, and every minute of battery life counts when you use your smartwatch for communication, workout tracking, and health monitoring. GPS services, a bright, always-on display, and continuous health sensors like SpO2 can squeeze the most juice out of your smartwatch.

Recent findings suggest that wear OS software is used by many of the most popular smartwatch brands, including Google, Samsung, and OnePlus. Both the Google Pixel Watch and Samsung Galaxy Watch’s largest batteries last approximately 40 hours. That’s nearly two days of use from two top Android smartwatches, but you’d be surprised how promptly it can drain.

Also: Galaxy Watch 9 review: Health data overload, but built for the future.

The revision improves battery life without customers having to take any action or change any settings — the Google Play Services version 26.45 works quietly under the hood.

That’s not the only Google Play Services revision that Wear OS smartwatch consumers can take advantage of. Another recent update lets users view on their phone a larger preview of any watch face they want to install on their smartwatch.

By James Halley – Nov 22, 2026 at 11:00AM EST.

10 stocks we like better than Consolidated Edison ›.

If you're looking for dependable dividend growth from stable utilities, Consolidated Edison (ED +0.23%) and Southern Organization (SO -0.17%) fit the bill.

ConEd, as it's more commonly known, has raised its dividend for 52 consecutive years, making it a Dividend King, one of the few companies that have raised their dividends for 50 or more consecutive years. ConEd has the longest uninterrupted dividend-growth streak among S&P 500 electric and gas utilities.

Southern Manufacturer has increased its dividend for 25 consecutive years and kept it the same or increased it for 79 consecutive years.

Here are three reasons to buy each stock and hold it for five or more years.

In the third quarter, ConEd reported nine-month earnings per share (EPS) of $5.44, up 12.3% year over year. The company, which serves more than 9 million people and 350,000 businesses in Upcoming York City and Westchester County, is seeing growth because of electrification needs in the New York area. The company provides electricity and natural gas and is the only steam utility in the United States.

NYSE · As of 4:00 PM ET 11/20/26.

Industry observers note that southern Manufacturer is also showing double-digit EPS growth. Through the first nine months, it reported EPS of $4.02, up 13% over the same period last year. It provides electricity and gas to 9 million customers in Georgia, Mississippi, Alabama, Tennessee, Virginia, and Illinois. Southern is seeing a huge uptick in electrification needs for newly introduced data centers in the South, with commercial sales rising 52% year over year in the third quarter.

Both companies, compared to competitors, have low debt-to-earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization (EBITDA) levels, giving them plenty of room to fund expansion.

It has been revealed that con Edison operates almost entirely as a pure-play regulated delivery utility. New York's regulatory framework includes revenue decoupling, which insulates Con Edison's top line from fluctuations in customer usage or mild weather. Its multiyear capital plan drives steady, predictable rate-base growth.

NYSE · As of 4:00 PM ET 11/20/26.

According to recent reports, southern is experiencing significant growth and has already paid for a lot of its expansion. Because Plant Vogtle Units 3 and 4 are in full operation, it has moved past the multiyear construction overhangs and cost-overrun risks that weighed on its balance sheet. Those nuclear units are now generating stable, regulated base-load returns and improving free cash flow generation.

Industry observers note that both dividends yield nearly three times the S&P 500 average of 1.11%. ConEd's dividend yield is 2.98% at its current share price, while Southern Firm's is 3.24%.

ConEd's annualized dividend of $3.55 per share is comfortably covered by 2026 adjusted earnings guidance of $6.05-$6.15 per share, keeping its payout ratio around 58%, well below the utility sector average, leaving a wide cushion against economic downturns.

Industry observers note that southern Manufacturer projects full-year EPS of $4.70. Its annualized dividend this year is $3.02, so its payout ratio is slightly higher at 64%, but still within the safety range for utilities.

ConEd is the better stock for stability. It has a low beta, and its history of dividend growth is unmatched within the industry. It may also be priced lower at this point, with a forward price-to-earnings (P/E) ratio of 19.48 to Southern Manufacturer's 20.10.

Southern Tech giant, however, has a slightly higher dividend yield and operates in states experiencing more rapid population and industrial growth than Upcoming York can expect. In 2026, Southern Company achieved its strongest weather-normalized retail electricity sales growth in nearly two decades (up 2.3% year to date), propelled by a 50% surge in data center electricity usage and more than 17 gigawatts of contracted large-load projects in its pipeline.

📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

In a recent development, meta promised to be carbon-neutral and water-positive by 2030 — that is, the company would offset as much carbon dioxide as it created and return more water to local watersheds than it used. But like every Substantial Tech company, Meta is sacrificing its climate goals for artificial intelligence and the data centers needed to run it.

In Meta’s 2026 sustainability report, released on Thursday, Meta’s data center and sustainability chiefs wrote that the organization is “re-evaluating our timelines, sequencing, and interim milestones — including the 2030 timeframe for our net zero emissions goal and our near-term intensity targets.” In an emailed statement to CNET, a Meta spokesperson added, “We remain committed to net zero, but are re-evaluating the 2030 timeline … We’ll continue to invest in emissions reductions.”.

It’s a disappointing, if unsurprising, announcement. Microsoft, Amazon and Google have also all backtracked on their climate goals in their rush to build hyperscale data centers, the turbocharged server farms needed to keep AI online. Microsoft’s president, Brad Smith, said in 2023 that the tech giant’s net zero goal was “before the explosion in artificial intelligence.”.

Sources indicate that meta’s net emissions in 2025 were 11.8 million metric tons of carbon dioxide, a 45% increase year over year, the company says. Carbon dioxide and other greenhouse gases are primary drivers of the climate crisis, worsening natural disasters, causing more extreme weather patterns and disrupting the lives of everyone and everything on the planet.

Industry observers note that take one of Meta’s Louisiana data centers, Hyperion, for example. CEO Mark Zuckerberg announced the behemoth in 2025, showing how the facility is nearly the size of Manhattan. When it comes online in 2030, it’s expected to create two gigawatts of capacity for AI, with the ability to scale in the future. But it also requires equally massive demands on the state’s energy grid.

Meta details in length its strategies for mitigating the environmental impact of its work, including improved water-use efficiencies in its data centers and approximately 77% less embodied carbon in its upcoming data center designs compared to its original ones.

Recent findings suggest that but, again, AI has made an indelible mark on those efforts. The company also reports that its electricity consumption “increased 35% year over year as additional data centers came online.”.

Meta wrote that “demand for AI infrastructure has grown faster than almost anyone projected.” Arguably, as one of the biggest hyperscalers driving the buildout of AI infrastructure here in the US and abroad, Meta should have known.

#62393. What to Buy (and Skip) on Black Friday 2026

What to Buy (and Skip) on Black Friday 2026

📅 19 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 5 min read (1041 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Nerdwallet

⏱️ ~5 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Black Friday comes but once a year — although sometimes it feels like it lasts for a month.
  • If you’ve been sitting on a holiday shopping list and waiting for prices to drop, we’ve got good news: It’s time to start your shopping engines!
  • In a recent development, you don’t need a calendar full of sale dates to navigate the shopping frenzy.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Black Friday comes but once a year — although sometimes it feels like it lasts for a month. The big day is Nov. 27, but the sales have already started.

If you’ve been sitting on a holiday shopping list and waiting for prices to drop, we’ve got good news: It’s time to start your shopping engines! (So to speak.).

In a recent development, you don’t need a calendar full of sale dates to navigate the shopping frenzy. Focus on the categories likely to offer the biggest savings. Here’s what to buy, and what can wait.

If you’ve got top-priority toys on your list, buy them at a discount if you can find them, states Kristin McGrath, senior editor at The Krazy Coupon Lady, “just in case they don’t go down in price later.”.

Non-electronic toys are a good bet, states Julie Ramhold, consumer analyst with DealNews.com, because they’re less affected by tariffs on electronic components. That includes Legos, dolls and playsets.

According to recent reports, neeDoh squishies are a hot stocking stuffer this year and may be in short supply. At authorized retailers like Target, they should be relatively affordable, but try to avoid unauthorized resellers who may crank up the price, Ramhold states.

While you may see mattress stores offering a few doorbusters on Black Friday, don’t feel pressured to jump on a deal.

Recent findings suggest that “Mattresses tend to see some of their strongest discounts around major sales events like Labor Day and Presidents Day,” says Ashley Feinstein Gerstley, shopping and savings strategist with Rakuten. “So if you’re not in a rush, it may be worth waiting for one of those windows.”.

Similarly, bedding and towels are often on deep discount during January white sales, Feinstein Gerstley indicates.

Got some counter space and an itch for a new food processor? Black Friday sales are a great time to price surf for countertop appliances, including blenders, juicers and air fryers.

“Those things we see sometimes half off or more,” McGrath claims. “And they’re all on sale at the same time, so any one you’re looking for is likely to have a discount.”.

Holiday decor is only a must-buy during Black Friday sales if you need it for this holiday season.

While you’ll still see sales on holiday items like artificial trees, drinkware and garlands, “if you can wait until after Christmas, that’s when discounts should reach up to 80% or more at stores like Target, Walmart and department stores like JCPenney and Macy’s,” Ramhold says.

Electronics are typically a slam-dunk buy at this time of year. “Every store is competing for your business, so televisions, headphones, tablets, laptops — they’re all going to be on sale at the same time,” McGrath says.

Industry observers note that gaming consoles, in particular, see some of the better discounts. And they often come bundled with a gift card, gaming accessories or video games. “Consoles are common gifts,” McGrath says. “The stores know that, so they’re offering competitive deals.”.

That mentioned, the traditional deep discounts you usually see on electronics for Black Friday may be a little lackluster this year due to high prices on parts, Ramhold says.

For best results, research the exact specs of the product you want and put it in your cart ahead of time, indicates consumer savings expert Andrea Woroch. That way, if a similar (but not identical) product goes on sale, you won’t accidentally buy the wrong thing.

You’ll usually find deeper discounts on items that are associated with fitness resolutions after Latest Year’s Day.

“Significant-box retailers like Target and department stores like Macy’s will offer up to 40% off or more on both fitness equipment and activewear during early January sales,” Ramhold states.

Many fashion retailers offer Black Friday sales, McGrath indicates. So if there’s an item you stock in multiple colors or a work staple you need to replace, keep an eye on your favorite sites for the markdowns.

Shoes, too, are a category to eyeball, including seasonal buys and everyday options like running shoes, Ramhold states. “Some retailers may offer a BOGO promotion of some kind, but it’ll likely just be a ‘buy one, get one for 50% off,’” she says.

Sources indicate that just shop early for your size and color before inventory runs low, McGrath says. “You don’t want to miss out if there's a great deal.”.

One caveat: Winter apparel will usually see bigger discounts toward the end of the year, Woroch states. So wait on your boot and coat purchases if you can.

Black Friday also offers the chance to snag deals on things you can use throughout the year:.

Photo gifts: Whether you’re ordering holiday cards or putting together a photo book for your in-laws (or yourself), you can usually find sales from vendors like Snapfish and Shutterfly, among others.

Sources indicate that fitness classes: Try your local gym, yoga or Pilates studio for discounts on class packs. “I’ll buy a 20-class package, and it’s always a great deal,” Woroch claims.

Spa services: Check local businesses for deals on massages, manicures and other self-care treatments.

Streaming subscriptions: If you’re a new customer (or canceled at least a month ago), some streaming platforms offer deep Black Friday discounts.

Black Friday deals are as much about strategy as savings, so make sure you’re maximizing your spending with these tips:.

Let AI help. Tools like ChatGPT and Gemini can do a lot of the legwork for you. Write out a product name and try prompts like “Find the lowest price for X product by comparing every retail site that it’s sold on and including coupons and cash back offers,” Woroch claims. (Just note that AI searches can be limited and may not find every deal available.).

Check the price, not just the percentage: “Sometimes the base price is inflated or it was listed initially for a higher price,” Feinstein Gerstley claims. “Another retailer might have the same item for less, even if their discount doesn't look as impressive.”.

Use a browser extension or cash-back app. As long as you’re spending money, recapture some of it with a browser extension or cash-back app that sends a percentage of your purchase back to you.

Signal Is Blocking Screenshots to Protect Your Messages from AI Agents

📅 20 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 3 min read (604 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Cnet

⏱️ ~3 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • Don’t ask your AI agent to read and decipher that lengthy text message.
  • The privacy-focused messaging and calling app is rolling out a latest default setting to stop built-in smartphone AI agents from potentially seeing and saving your Signal data.
  • Industry observers note that that threatens Signal’s mission to guarantee privacy, Whittaker wrote.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

Don’t ask your AI agent to read and decipher that lengthy text message. And don’t screenshot it either. It may seem harmless, but Signal’s latest setting underlines that it isn’t.

The privacy-focused messaging and calling app is rolling out a latest default setting to stop built-in smartphone AI agents from potentially seeing and saving your Signal data. In a blog post announcing the change, Signal President Meredith Whittaker remarked these AI bots scan what’s on your screen to get to know you, capturing your data and making it available to AI systems to fulfill your requests, such as answering questions you may ask.

Industry observers note that that threatens Signal’s mission to guarantee privacy, Whittaker wrote. So it’s putting a stop to it with a default setting to block screenshots in the Signal app on iOS 27 and when AI assistants try to capture information on Android screens by default.

Whittaker noted that this isn’t the first time Signal has taken such measures against an operating system. Last year, it blocked screenshots of Signal messages from Microsoft’s Recall AI on Windows 11.

Now the firm is taking a similar approach to Apple’s iOS 27 and Android operating systems, where AI assistants try to read your Signal screen.

According to recent reports, the problem is the same for the three major OS companies. Microsoft, Google and Apple are incorporating AI into their operating systems, and Signal says that compromises the space for third-party developers, including Signal, to build apps for these systems.

“Right now, these agentic AI integrations are changing this environment in a way that’s making it increasingly hostile to privacy,” Whittaker wrote.

Whittaker said the screenshot setting won’t fix everything, because AI agents can still sneakily access data on your phone. Tech companies should take steps to give developers more choice, such as an opt-out to disable AI agent access, and provide more documentation on how significant tech AI agents work.

Industry observers note that “Even where we are able to detect and block AI data access, Google, Apple, Microsoft and others do not provide ways for developers to easily restrict such AI data access without making drastic compromises to the core user experience,” Whittaker said. “This is also the reason we are currently unable to implement these protections on MacOS.”.

In most cases, text messages are encrypted when they travel between devices. But AI agents can bypass that. John Strand, CEO of Black Hills Information Security, explained that when you access the information, it has to be decrypted because you cannot read encrypted data.

In a recent development, “So, if an AI agent can access screenshots or directly observe what’s happening on your screen, it can read those messages without ever having to break the encryption itself,” said Strand. “That’s the scary part. You can have incredibly strong encryption, but if something can see what the user sees, that encryption isn’t going to protect you at that point.”.

If you want to take screenshots in Signal, you can disable the setting, but that could mean AI agents could access you and your senders’ information, like text messages and shared files such as photos.

In a recent development, strand mentioned the worst-case scenario is that an attacker could see everything you see, from private conversations to passwords. And that’s what Signal is trying to avoid.

“They want to make sure that if something like this happens, they’ve done absolutely everything they reasonably can to protect their customers and the information being accessed through their application,” Strand mentioned.

Signal, Apple and Google did not immediately respond to requests for comment.

Industry News: Don't Give Up on Realty Income in a Rising-Rate Environment; It Can Easily Survive Until the Property Market Adjusts

📅 22 Nov 2026 | ⏱️ 4 min read (756 words, 📚 Deep Dive) | Source: Fool

⏱️ ~4 mins left to finish
📖 0% read
💡 Key Takeaways
  • By Reuben Gregg Brewer – Nov 22, 2026 at 11:18AM EST.
  • Recent findings suggest that rising interest rates are not good for real estate investment trusts (REITs).
  • Sources indicate that like most real estate investment trusts, Realty Income makes extensive use of leverage.
📑 Quick Jump: 1. Overview • 2. Key Details • 3. Closing Notes

By Reuben Gregg Brewer – Nov 22, 2026 at 11:18AM EST.

10 stocks we like better than Realty Income ›.

Recent findings suggest that rising interest rates are not good for real estate investment trusts (REITs). That's a major concern for investors today who own Realty Income (O +0.64%) or are considering buying it. Don't use interest rates as an excuse to skip past this stock and its attractive 5.6% dividend yield. Realty Income is prepared for the impact of rising rates, and history demonstrates that the headwinds are likely to be temporary. Here's why this giant net-lease REIT is still a buy for conservative dividend investors.

Sources indicate that like most real estate investment trusts, Realty Income makes extensive use of leverage. When interest rates go up, debt becomes more expensive. That, in turn, puts pressure on profits. There's no easy way around that fact, but it isn't the end of the world. In fact, it's just the normal ebb and flow of the economy. And Realty Income has proven it can ride the wave, noting that it has increased its dividend annually for 32 consecutive years.

To be fair, Realty Income is much larger today than it was 32 years ago. At this point, it is the largest public net lease REIT with a portfolio of more than 15,500 properties. (A net lease requires tenants to pay for most property-level operating costs.) Given the company's size and its investment-grade balance sheet, it tends to have an advantage in access to capital markets.

According to recent reports, however, that scale is crucial in another way because it has given the tech giant the leeway to diversify. For example, it generates around 20% of its rents from Europe, where the net lease sector is still fairly small. Europe also has slightly different interest rate dynamics from those of the United States. Realty Income has also entered new areas, including asset management, partnerships, and lending. All of these help to offset the impact of rising rates as well.

So, from a business perspective, Realty Income has not only proven it can survive interest rate volatility but is also better prepared today than ever before. However, the real reason dividend investors should consider buying the REIT today, despite rising rates, is related to timing.

The big reason why rising rates are a problem is that they make buying fresh properties less profitable. That's not good, but rates don't operate in a vacuum. Think about it for a second: if rates rose to the point where it was unprofitable to buy property, then nobody would buy property. The property market would crawl to a standstill.

In a recent development, that can't happen for an extended period. Property owners with debt coming due and property developers will need to sell assets if they don't want to default on their loans. To avoid that fate, they will be forced to lower prices to the point where buyers are willing to step back in. In Realty Income's experience, such market adjustments take roughly a year.

NYSE · As of 4:00 PM ET 11/20/26.

That said, there are more players in the market today than historically, which Realty Income believes could shorten the adjustment period somewhat. But the real takeaway is that property markets will eventually adjust and buying new assets will become attractive again. Thus, Realty Income isn't facing a permanent headwind, but a temporary one. So all it has to do is get by until the property markets adjust. As noted above, it is better positioned than ever to do just that.

Recent findings suggest that all of that mentioned, Realty Income is meant to be a boring, slow-growth dividend stock. It is a foundational investment that allows you to sleep well at night and, perhaps, add lower-yielding but higher-growth businesses to your portfolio. This high-yield stock won't excite you, but that's the point. And its ability to support its dividend (and actually continue to grow it) amid the uncertainty of a rising-rate environment is actually evidence that it is the type of dividend stock you'll want to own for the long term.
